title: To the extent that
titleZh: 「to the extent that」表示「程度上的依存關係」
titleEn: Using To the extent that for a relationship of degree

source.file: Sentence Structuee 177 - Using _to the extent that_.pdf
omissions: English versions of Chinese-only Important Rules are faithful editorial translations.

formula: Main clause + to the extent that + complete clause

formulas.formula: Main clause + to the extent that + complete clause

example: People succeed to the extent that they are willing to learn from failure.
exampleZh: 人能成功的程度，取決於他們願意從失敗中學習的程度。

examples.en: People succeed to the extent that they are willing to learn from failure.
examples.zh: 人能成功的程度，取決於他們願意從失敗中學習的程度。
examples.highlight: People succeed to the extent that they are willing to learn from failure.

rules.zh: that 後面必須接完整子句，即要有主語和動詞。
rules.en: Use a complete clause after that, with both a subject and a verb.

rules.zh: 當兩個概念都可以有程度上的變化時才使用這個句型；它不只是表達 一次性的原因。
rules.en: Use the structure when both ideas can change by degree. It is not merely a one-time reason.

rules.zh: 本練習的每個答案都要保留 that。
rules.en: Keep that in every answer in this exercise.

rules.zh: 不要把它與 to an extent（「在某程度上／部分地」）或 to such an extent that（「到如此程度以致……」，表示結果）混淆。
rules.en: Do not confuse it with to an extent (“partly”) or to such an extent that (“so much that”, showing a result).

rules.zh: 改寫時要保留原句的時態、情態動詞、行動者和意思。
rules.en: Preserve the original tense, modal verb, actor, and meaning.

benefits.zh: 讀者可以立即看出，一個結果會隨另一個條件的程度而改變。
benefits.en: It makes a degree relationship clear — The reader can see immediately that one result changes according to another condition.

benefits.zh: 你不必把事情說成完全成功、公平、實用或可靠，而可以清楚說明這個 說法成立到甚麼程度。
benefits.en: It helps you make balanced claims — Instead of saying something is completely successful, fair, useful, or reliable, you can show the limits of your claim.

benefits.zh: 你可以把使用 depends on how much／how well 的較長解釋，改寫成 一句連接緊密的句子。
benefits.en: It can shorten a long explanation — You can replace a longer sentence with "depends on how much/how well" by one connected sentence.

benefits.zh: 這個句型把結果和條件放在同一句中，讓讀者更容易理解兩者的關係。
benefits.en: It connects related ideas smoothly — The structure puts the result and the condition in one sentence, so the reader can follow the relationship more easily.

benefits.zh: 你可以在作文、報告和討論中，更準確地評估成功、公平、成效、可靠 性、責任等概念。 Before-and-after comparison 改寫前後比較 （計劃有多成功，取決於團隊執行得有多仔細。） （計劃能成功到甚麼程度，取決於團隊執行得有多仔細。）
benefits.en: It is useful in essays, reports, and discussions — You can use it to evaluate success, fairness, effectiveness, reliability, responsibility, and similar ideas more precisely. Before-and-after comparison How successful the plan is depends on how carefully the team follows it. The plan will succeed to the extent that the team follows it carefully.
examples: The plan will succeed to the extent that the team follows it carefully.

sourceOmissions: English versions of Chinese-only Important Rules are faithful editorial translations.
